note: Six downloaded hero ships kept for now (owner decision 2026-09-24). The game shows them under original names (see `game`). Licences re-checked on Sketchfab on 2026-09-24 (all still CC BY or CC BY-SA and downloadable). They are fan-art of a third-party franchise: credit is required, but the credits do not cover the franchise itself, so replace them before any commercial release. The four crew figures listed here earlier were removed from the game (three showed signs of extraction from a commercial game); see docs/aaa-overhaul/audits/assets-and-licensing.md. New v2 models (enemies, bosses, props, crew, nature) are in /assets/fleet/manifest.json.

ships.author: Miraculousetabug

license.label: CC Attribution
license.requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.

ships.changes: Uniform scale, rotation and waterline translation; preserved source meshes and UVs; material styling, mesh simplification, WebP textures and Meshopt compression. 2026-09-25 material re-bake (scripts/assets/atlas-hero.mjs): the 36 materials became 6 (31 textures copied texel for texel into one atlas with wrap-padded gutters, triangles split along the texture's repeat lines; 5 heavily repeating textures kept as they were); geometry and texels unchanged; the low file keeps 1×1 placeholder images and per-vertex atlas UVs for the captain hull bake.
ships.provenance: Medium-confidence doubt: five texture files are byte-identical to an unrelated earlier upload (8cf21462, a Going Merry by RadhruinT), suggesting a shared unknown source. First to replace if provenance is questioned.
